summary: Prepare the isolated iOS test-client scanning-key lifecycle and claim proof; submission fails closed pending the generated claim SDK

replay.detail: Existing completed pairings retain their credentials and keys.

schema.detail: No generated SDK files are changed.

rules.detail: When Expo extra.testClientMode is true, create the device key before opening the camera, require pairing-key-binding v2, sign the pairing.claim.v1 message, and require a successful claim before transferring that same key to completion. Claim submission currently refuses pending the generated SDK; there is no unbound fallback.

compatibility.detail: Absent or false testClientMode preserves the normal app pairing path. The test variant cannot complete a new pairing until the generated claim SDK binding ships.

downtime.detail: No deployment or native build is performed.

manual.detail: The test app reports that scanning-key claim submission is unavailable; update after the generated claim SDK ships. Normal app pairing instructions are unchanged.

recovery.detail: Cancelled or refused scans discard their candidate keys without replacing the saved pairing.
